title: Claude Code token limits fixed with four essential plugins
description: Claude Code’s token limits often interrupt coding tasks, but four powerful plugins can eliminate this issue entirely. OmniRoot expands Claude Code’s capabilities by connecting it to over 200 free AI models, enabling automatic switching when token limits are reached for practically unlimited input capacity. Headroom optimizes prompt efficiency by compressing inputs, significantly reducing token usage on large tasks. ClaudeMem enhances productivity by providing Claude Code with long-term memory across sessions, eliminating the need to repeatedly explain codebases. Claude Code Setup analyzes your workflow and codebase to create custom AI skills for repetitive tasks while recommending the most effective MCPs and sub-agents to streamline your development process. Together, these plugins vastly improve Claude Code’s usability and capacity for complex coding workflows. #ClaudeCode #OmniRoot #HeadroomPlugin #ClaudeMem #ClaudeCodeSetup #AICodingTools #TokenLimitFix #CodeAutomation #AIWorkflow #MCPs #SubAgents #AIPlugins #CodebaseManagement #DeveloperTools #AICodingAssistant
